answer.name: Recruiter Invitation
answer.subject: You've Been Invited to Join as a Recruiter
answer.description: Sent by Supabase Auth when a recruiter is invited via inviteUserByEmail. Managed in the Supabase dashboard email templates.

answer.name: Confirm Signup (Email Verification)
answer.subject: Confirm Your Email & Complete Your Setup
answer.description: Sent automatically by Supabase Auth when a new jobseeker account is created, or when a verification resend is requested. Managed in the Supabase dashboard email templates.

answer.name: Onboarding Reminder
answer.subject: Complete Your Account Setup - Action Required
answer.description: Sent in two scenarios: (#2b) when a recruiter has verified their email but not completed onboarding; (#15) on a jobseeker's first login if they have not yet completed their profile.

answer.name: Jobseeker Welcome
answer.subject: Welcome to Ops Portal
answer.description: Sent when a new jobseeker profile is created by a recruiter.

answer.name: Jobseeker Position Assignment
answer.subject: Assignment Confirmation: Warehouse Associate at Acme Logistics Inc. (Toronto)
answer.description: Sent when a jobseeker is assigned to a new position.

answer.name: Jobseeker Position Removal
answer.subject: Update Regarding Your Position Assignment
answer.description: Sent when a jobseeker is removed from a position assignment.

answer.name: Timesheet Summary
answer.subject: Timesheet Summary - Timesheet #TS-2026-0107
answer.description: Sent when a timesheet is submitted, re-sent, or updated. Contains the full hours and pay breakdown.

answer.name: Invoice
answer.subject: Invoice #INV-2026-0042 for Acme Corporation
answer.description: Sent when an invoice is generated and emailed to a client.

answer.name: Digital Consent Request
answer.subject: Digital Consent Request: Employment Agreement 2026
answer.description: Sent when a digital consent request is created or resent for a user to review and sign.

answer.name: Employment Agreement
answer.subject: Action Required: Sign Your Employment Agreement
answer.description: Sent when a jobseeker's email is confirmed (#14, alongside the welcome email) or when a recruiter creates a profile (#13), prompting the jobseeker to sign the employment agreement.
